description: This PHP class 'SiteConfigurationExcluder' manages exclusion of site configuration files from staging and deployment processes within Drupal's package management system. It handles excluding specific configuration files, making site directories writable, and synchronizing permissions between live and staged environments.

classes.name: SiteConfigurationExcluder
classes.description: Handles exclusion of site configuration files from staging, making directories writable, and syncing permissions in Drupal's package management process.

methods.name: excludeSiteConfiguration
methods.description: Adds site configuration files to the exclusion list for staging.

methods.name: makeDefaultSiteDirectoryWritable
methods.description: Changes permissions of the default site directory to be owner-writable.

methods.name: syncDefaultSiteDirectoryPermissions
methods.description: Synchronizes permissions of the staged 'sites/default' directory with the live environment.

methods.name: getDefaultSiteDirectoryPath
methods.description: Constructs the full path to 'sites/default' based on a given root directory.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this class subscribes to for handling.
